source_documents.title: Schiff base derivatives based on diaminomaleonitrile: Colorimetric and fluorescent recognition of Cu(II), cell imaging application, polymorph-dependent fluorescence and aggregation-enhanced emission

reference_evidence_units.quote: Two different polymorphs of compound 1 were obtained from ethanol and ethyl acetate, respectively, which exhibit obvious differences in the wavelength and intensity of the fluorescence emission.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Yellow (527 nm) vs weaker red (655 nm) crystals.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Such close packing model results in the red shift of the emission peak.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 1 and 2 show pronounced solvatochromic performance when excited at 420 and 382 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission 462 → 551 nm with polarity (dipolar excited state).

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results indicate a 1:1 ratio for 1-Cu2+ complex, in which one Cu2+ ion is bound with one molecule 1.
